length_confound_check.note: Length itself barely tracks half-life on these records, so length is not a confound in this project's prediction; it is a confound only in the paper's summed columns.

no_claim: A correlation is not a calibration. No absolute accuracy is established.
The held-out records are a different reporter and a wider length and half-life range than the training subset, so model failure and distribution shift cannot be separated with this data alone.
The training-subset figures are an upper bound on what the model can do, not a result; the model was fitted on those records.
This says nothing about the translation side, about in-cell stability, or about the project's own 1811 nt construct, which lies outside this dataset's ranges.
purpose: The first external test of strand_rnafold_calibration_v1 against measured values it was not fitted on.

rows.name: humanHBB_Eterna_MEV_HBB_F30Pepper_Steve's Mod of Omei's 59 pairs Epitope #4

source.measured_quantity: in-solution half-life in hours, from In-line-seq degradation fitted to a single exponential

verdict.declared_falsification: Spearman rho at or below 0 means the calibration does not transfer to records it was not fitted on. That outcome is reportable and will be reported.
verdict.declared_weak_threshold: rho below 0.3 is to be described as no useful transfer rather than as weak success

what_this_cannot_establish: Absolute accuracy. A correlation is not a calibration.
That the calibration transfers to the project's own construct, which is 1811 nt and 64.4 percent GC, outside this dataset's length and GC ranges.
Anything about the translation side. RiboNN is untouched by this run.
Anything about in-cell stability, which is a different quantity again.
That a positive result validates the design workflow. The workflow's predicted differences between synonymous variants span a few percent, far below the spread tested here.
